text:
raj: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — the streaming/chat regression observed yesterday. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/183765 — please use this thread to confirm owners and timelines.

maya: Ack. I’ll own the retry/backoff change and can push a safe canary by EOD.

alex: I’ll take observability gaps (missing KV cache metric and streaming disconnect counts). ETA Wednesday.

toncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-183765 streaming-partial-outputs. Priority: P2.

raj: @maya for the retry logic: prioritize short-term patch that forces linear backoff for requests that hit a 408/5xx within 500ms of start. Long-term we want adaptive backoff based on queue depth.

maya: Agree. Short patch: implement backoff policy and add test for immediate reconnect storms. Patch branch: `fix/streaming-retry-linear`

sam: I’ll work on API gateway timeout config — we saw 10s timeouts getting cut off by LB at 9.8s. Will align LB + app timeouts. ETA tomorrow morning.

raj: Also we need to track customer impact windows and correlate to SDK versions. @alex add a query to the usage dashboard for client versions that saw reconnects.

alex: Will add. Quick query snippet I’ll run: ```sql
SELECT client_version, count(*) as disconnects
FROM streaming_events
WHERE event_type = 'disconnect' AND ts >= '2026-03-10'
GROUP BY client_version
ORDER BY disconnects DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

maya: One risk: KV cache invalidation race when we perform model hot-swap. My short-term fix: delay cache eviction by 150ms and drain inflight requests. Longer term: switch to epoch-based cache keys.

tess: (product) For customers with dedicated capacity, do we need a communication plan? I can draft a note summarizing mitigations and ETA.

raj: Yes please @tess. Keep it clear: commit to improved metrics + canary rollout by EOD, full rollout next week if canary stable.

maya: I’ll post the canary results here. Basic smoke test: 1k streaming reqs/min for 30m with no partials.

sam: LB timeout change deployed to canary cluster now. Will monitor.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly incident sync Thu 9am — add this as agenda item.

raj: Action items summary (quick):
- maya: retry/backoff patch + canary (owner: maya, ETA: today EOD)
- alex: add disconnect metrics + client-version query (owner: alex, ETA: Wed)
- sam: LB + gateway timeout alignment (owner: sam, ETA: tomorrow AM)
- tess: customer comms draft (owner: tess, ETA: tomorrow PM)
- raj: follow up and confirm rollouts + postmortem addendum (owner: raj, ETA: Fri)

maya: noted. tagging Jira tickets now: RW-INC-4321, RW-OBS-129.

alex: FYI I found a recurring pattern: small spikes in concurrent connections right before partial responses. I’ll add a heatmap to the dashboard.

raj: Great. If anyone hits blockers comment here. Otherwise we’ll checkin in the weekly sync and I’ll update the postmortem with this action tracker. :thumbsup:
